description: Create a dynamic SLD style named 'dynamic_country' in the 'ne' workspace. This style must highlight a specific country in Red (#FF0000) based on the environment variable 'target_country' passed in the WMS request URL, while rendering all other countries in Gray (#CCCCCC). Use the 'env' SLD function to achieve this. Finally, verify your work by saving a map image highlighting Brazil to '/home/ga/highlight_brazil.png' (using parameters env=target_country:Brazil).
